note: P11b/P11c: W2 shows the drive profile stays generic DVD (0x0010) inside the netemu partition; the secure service requires the PS2 profile (0xFF60/61) and rejects with 0x16. Static analysis: guest ATAPI cannot change it; the candidate fix is on the hypervisor side (a patch to the secure service check or to how the PS2 partition is created), not in netemu.

Disc authentication (likely required for any data read)
Level 2: emulator disc layer reads from the drive (boot)
Level 4: usable (app, stub ISO, configs, no-disc messages)
